Microsoft is seeking a Software Engineer to join the Microsoft Specialized Cloud team. The role focuses on building and operating highly secure cloud platforms, services, and developer experiences for U.S. Government customers, with responsibilities spanning distributed systems, APIs, reliability, security, compliance, and operational readiness.

Responsibilities
Contribute to the design and evolution of scalable distributed systems, APIs, services, and platform capabilities, balancing requirements related to security, reliability, performance, maintainability, and cost
Develop automated tests, monitoring, telemetry, and operational tooling to improve software quality, observability, and long-term service health
Apply security, privacy, and compliance best practices throughout the software development lifecycle while working within specialized cloud environments
Diagnose, debug, and resolve technical issues across the software stack, using data and telemetry to improve performance, reliability, and maintainability over time
Design, implement, test, and maintain software features and services that meet customer and product requirements while operating within specialized security and compliance constraints
Participate in operational activities, including monitoring, incident response, and readiness reviews, to ensure services remain dependable in specialized and restricted environments
Partner with product managers, designers, security engineers, infrastructure teams, and engineering peers to deliver customer-focused solutions
Learn new technologies, tools, and engineering practices while contributing to a culture of knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and technical growth
Collaborate with teammates to analyze requirements, review designs and code, and continuously improve engineering quality, reliability, and operational readiness
Embody our culture and values

Required
* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
  + OR equivalent experience
* The successful candidate must have an active U.S. Government Top Secret Security Clearance. Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. Failure to maintain or obtain the appropriate clearance and/or customer screening requirements may result in employment action up to and including termination
* **Citizenship & Citizenship Verification:** This position requires verification of U.S. citizenship due to citizenship-based legal restrictions. Specifically, this position supports United States federal, state, and/or local United States government agency customer and is subject to certain citizenship-based restrictions where required or permitted by applicable law. To meet this legal requirement, citizenship will be verified via a valid passport, or other approved documents, or verified US government Clearance
Preferred
* Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field with proven experience coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python 
  + OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 2+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
  + OR equivalent experience
* Experience building cloud-native applications or services on Azure or another major cloud platform
* Experience with distributed systems, microservices, APIs, or large-scale backend services
* Experience with containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, or modern CI/CD practices
* Experience using telemetry, monitoring, logging, or observability solutions to diagnose and improve system health
* Experience developing applications for regulated, security-sensitive, or highly available environments
* Experience applying AI-assisted development tools or building AI-enabled applications
